# A test reaches into instances on every target, each file a shape a review
# found answered wrongly somewhere: a copy's record released on Destroy alone
# (copies), a reached node whose id a target reserves (reserved), a copy of a
# copy (nested), a program's own call through an instance a test reaches
# into (sitecall), an event fired two instances down (deepfire), an empty
# handler under a loop (emptyfocus), a sngl:seq loop's variable in a prop
# (seq), a handler forwarding what it bound nothing of (forward), a nested
# list that shrinks (shrink), and an instance whose body renders nothing
# while its call site is rendered, which is present (present). A call site
# in a page's content, which renders only while the page shows (page), under
# an `if` on a context (context), under a condition on a prop the test cannot
# name (unnamedcond), and a copy reached through a copy of an outer loop that
# shrank away (gone) are each answered by the target or the interpreter. An
# event no call site handles is an error everywhere (unhandled), and a prop
# read that reads what a test cannot name through an instance is refused
# (unnamed). A node the build folded away is absent, and a branch on it is
# decided (folded), held in a local as well (foldedread); a local holding a
# node that is rendered reads it (heldread). html is left out of page: a
# navigation ends the document a test runs in.

sngl test --platform=none copies.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html copies.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- copies.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component tile(label string, @tapped(n int)) node {
    var taps = 0
    text #face(value="<{label}:{taps}>")
    button #tap(text="tap", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
        tapped(taps)
    })
}

component main node {
    var names list[string] = ["a", "b", "c"]
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        for var i, n = names {
            tile #r(label="{i}{n}", @tapped(k) {
                log = log + "{n}{k};"
            })
        }
        button #rev(text="rev", @click {
            names = ["c", "b", "a"]
        })
        button #drop(text="drop", @click {
            names = ["b", "c"]
        })
    }
}

func testReorder(t Test, c main) {
    c.r[0].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[0].taps == 1)
    t.assert(c.log == "a1;")
    c.rev.click()
    t.assert(c.r[0].label == "0c")
    t.assert(c.r[0].face.value == "<0c:{c.r[0].taps}>")
    c.r[0].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.log == "a1;c{c.r[0].taps};")
    c.r[2].tapped(9)
    t.assert(c.log == "a1;c{c.r[0].taps};a9;")
}

func testDrop(t Test, c main) {
    c.r[2].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[2].taps == 1)
    c.drop.click()
    t.assert(c.r[2] == null)
    t.assert(c.r[1].label == "1c")
    c.r[1].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.log == "c1;c{c.r[1].taps};")
}

window {
    main
}
-- reserved.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #m(text="hit", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
    })
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    vbox {
        if show {
            badge #b(label="one")
        }
    }
}

func testReserved(t Test, c main) {
    if c.b != null {
        c.b.m.click()
        t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- nested.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component cell(label string) node {
    var taps = 0
    button #m(text="{label}:{taps}", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
    })
}

component row(items list[string], tag string) node {
    var bump = 0
    hbox {
        for var j, it = items {
            cell #cl(label="{tag}{j}{it}{bump}")
        }
        button #b(text="b", @click {
            bump = bump + 1
        })
    }
}

component main node {
    var grid list[list[string]] = [["a", "b"], ["c", "d", "e"]]
    vbox {
        for var i, items = grid {
            row #r(items=items, tag="R{i}")
        }
        button #swap(text="s", @click {
            grid = [["x"], ["y", "z"]]
        })
    }
}

func testNested(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[2].label == "R12e0")
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[2].m.text == "R12e0:0")
    c.r[1].cl[2].m.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[2].taps == 1)
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[2].m.text == "R12e0:1")
    c.r[1].b.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[0].label == "R10c1")
    c.swap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[1].label == "R11z1")
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[2] == null)
    t.assert(c.r[0].cl[0].label == "R00x0")
}

window {
    main
}
-- sitecall.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    func reset() {
        hits = 0
    }
    button #hit(text="{label}{hits}", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
    })
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    vbox {
        badge #b(label="one")
        badge #o(label="two")
        button #clear(text="c", @click {
            b.reset()
            o.reset()
        })
    }
}

func testProgramCall(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.hit.click()
    c.b.hit.click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 2)
    c.clear.click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 0)
    t.assert(c.b.hit.text == "one0")
}

window {
    main
}
-- deepfire.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component tile(label string, @tapped(n int)) node {
    var taps = 0
    button #tap(text="tap", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
        tapped(taps)
    })
}

component panel(tag string) node {
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        tile #t(label="x", @tapped(k) {
            log = log + "{tag}{k};"
        })
        for var n = ["a", "b"] {
            tile #u(label=n, @tapped(k) {
                log = log + "{n}{k};"
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    vbox {
        if show {
            panel #p(tag="P")
        }
        panel #q(tag="Q")
    }
}

func testFire(t Test, c main) {
    if c.p != null {
        c.p.t.tapped(5)
        t.assert(c.p.log == "P5;")
        c.p.u[1].tapped(6)
        t.assert(c.p.log == "P5;b6;")
        c.p.t.tap.click()
        t.assert(c.p.log == "P5;b6;P1;")
    } else {
        t.assert(false)
    }
    c.q.u[0].tapped(2)
    t.assert(c.q.log == "a2;")
    t.assert(c.q.t.taps == 0)
}

window {
    main
}
-- emptyfocus.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var xs list[int] = [1, 2]
    vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            button #k(text="k", @click {})
        }
    }
}

func testEmptyLoop(t Test, c main) {
    c.k[1].click()
    t.assert(c.xs.length() == 2)
}

window {
    main
}
-- seq.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import seq "sngl:seq"

component tile(label string) node {
    var taps = 0
    button #tap(text="{label}", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
    })
}

component main node {
    var k = 3
    vbox {
        for var i = seq.count(k) {
            tile #r(label="L{i}")
        }
    }
}

func testSeq(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.r[1].label == "L1")
    c.r[1].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].taps == 1)
    t.assert(c.r[1].tap.text == "L1")
}

window {
    main
}
-- forward.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component pick(@chose(a int, b string)) node {
    button #go(text="go", @click {
        chose(1, "x")
    })
}

component wrap(@picked(a int, b string)) node {
    var on = true
    if on {
        pick #p(@chose {
            picked()
        })
    }
}

component main node {
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        wrap #w(@picked(n, s) {
            log = log + "{n}{s};"
        })
    }
}

func testForward(t Test, c main) {
    if c.w.p != null {
        c.w.p.go.click()
        t.assert(c.log == "1x;")
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- shrink.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component cell(label string) node {
    var taps = 0
    button #tap(text="{label}:{taps}", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
    })
}

    var bump = 0
    hbox {
        for var j, it = items {
            cell #cl(label="{tag}{j}{it}{bump}")
        }
        button #b(text="b", @click {
            bump = bump + 1
        })
    }

component main node {
    var grid list[list[string]] = [["a", "b"], ["c", "d", "e"]]
    vbox {
        for var i, items = grid {
            row #r(items=items, tag="R{i}")
        }
        button #swap(text="s", @click {
            grid = [["x"], ["y", "z"]]
        })
    }
}

func testNested(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[2] != null)
    c.swap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[2] == null)
}

func testNested2(t Test, c main) {
    c.swap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[1].label == "R11z0")
}

window {
    main
}
-- present.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component two(a bool, b bool) node {
    if a {
        text(value="y")
    }
    if b {
        text(value="z")
    }
}

const xs list[int] = [1, 2]

component main node {
    var fa = true
    var fb = true
    vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            two #w(a=fa, b=fb)
        }
        button #offb(text="b", @click {
            fb = false
        })
        button #offa(text="a", @click {
            fa = false
        })
    }
}

func testTwoRoots(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.w[0] != null)
    c.offb.click()
    t.assert(c.w[0] != null)
}

func testNone(t Test, c main) {
    c.offb.click()
    c.offa.click()
    t.assert(c.w[0] != null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- page.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"

component blank node {
    text(value="y")
}

component main node {
    vbox {
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
                blank #w
            }
            nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About") {
                text(value="about")
            }
        }
        button #go(text="go", @click {
            pages.go(about)
        })
    }
}

func testPage(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.w != null)
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.w == null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- context.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

context #mode(true)

component blank node {
    text(value="y")
}

component holder node {
    vbox {
        if mode {
            blank #w
        }
        text(value="h")
    }
}

component main node {
    vbox {
        mode(false) {
            holder #p
        }
    }
}

func testContext(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.p.w == null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- unnamedcond.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component blank node {
    text(value="y")
}

component holder(show bool) node {
    if show {
        blank #w
    }
}

component outer(xs iter[int]) node {
    vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            holder #p(show=x > 1)
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var ys = [1, 2]
    outer #q(xs=ys)
}

func testNested(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.q.p[0].w == null)
    t.assert(c.q.p[1].w != null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- gone.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component cell(label string) node {
    var taps = 0
    button #tap(text="{label}:{taps}", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
    })
}

component row(items list[string]) node {
    var bump = 0
    hbox {
        for var it = items {
            cell #cl(label=it)
        }
        button #b(text="b", @click {
            bump = bump + 1
        })
    }
}

component main node {
    var grid list[list[string]] = [["a", "b"], ["c", "d", "e"]]
    vbox {
        for var items = grid {
            row #r(items=items)
        }
        button #drop(text="d", @click {
            grid = [["x"]]
        })
    }
}

func testGone(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[0] != null)
    c.drop.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].cl[0] == null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- folded.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

const shown = false

component a node {
    vbox {
        if shown {
            text #t(value="a")
            button #b(text="b")
        }
        text(value="x")
    }
}

component b node {
    text #t(value="b")
}

component main node {
    vbox {
        a #p
        b #q
    }
}

func testFolded(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.p.t == null)
    t.assert(c.q.t != null)
    if c.p.t != null {
        t.assert(c.p.t.value == "a")
    }
    if c.p.b != null {
        c.p.b.click()
    } else {
        t.assert(c.p.b == null)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- foldedread.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

const shown = false

component a node {
    vbox {
        if shown {
            text #t(value="a")
        }
        text(value="x")
    }
}

component main node {
    a #p
}

func testRead(t Test, c main) {
    var v = c.p.t
    if v != null {
        t.assert(v.value == "a")
    }
}

window {
    main
}

-- unhandled.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component tile(@tapped(n int)) node {
    button #tap(text="tap", @click {
        tapped(1)
    })
}

component main node {
    tile #z
}

func testUnhandled(t Test, c main) {
    c.z.tapped(5)
}

window {
    main
}
-- unnamed.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component tile(label string) node {
    text #face(value=label)
}

component strip(xs iter[string]) node {
    vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            tile #r(label=x)
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var names list[string] = ["a", "b"]
    strip #s(xs=names)
}

func testUnnamed(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.s.r[0].label == "a")
}

window {
    main
}
